title: infect everyone when your a zombie
features:
Get revenge on everyone for not protecting you


open source because it's very easy to make
script:
local players = game:GetService("Players")
local lp = players.LocalPlayer
local function infect(player)
if player == lp then return end
local hitbox = lp.Character:FindFirstChild("Hitbox")
if hitbox then
if hitbox:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TouchTransmitter") then
firetouchinterest(hitbox, player.Character.Hitbox, 0)
task.wait()
firetouchinterest(hitbox, player.Character.Hitbox, 1)
end
end
end

for i, v in pairs(players:GetChildren()) do
task.wait()
infect(v)
end

lp.Character.AttributeChanged:Connect(function(an)
if an == "IsZombie" and lp.Character:GetAttribute("IsZombie") == true then
for i, v in pairs(players:GetChildren()) do
task.wait()
infect(v)
end
end
end)
